name: mini-invoice-approval-desk
description: Mini Invoice Approval Desk - a small take-home project for reviewing and approving vendor invoices

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w web
